then.prompt: Remove a steam counter from Boom Grenade? (If not, it is destroyed.)

_comment:
Identical to .drafts/boom_grenade_blue.json except DEAL_GENERIC amount 3 vs 2 - see that file's comment for the full reasoning. Printed Crank is a card-DB keyword, not authored. Entry counter + upkeep destroy-unless-remove copy the shipped assembly_module_blue/teklo_core pattern (CONDITIONAL wraps MAY; gate on 'when', not ability-level conditions). ON_HIT reaches items via engine._dsl_hit_listener's broadcast over _dsl_permanent_zones(attacker); ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO is required because 'hit' fires for any damaged target. DEAL_GENERIC passes this card as the damage source (release note 2); DESTROY_SELF before DEAL_GENERIC in one execution still deals the damage (release note 3).

ON_HIT means 'when THIS hits' -- it is dispatched to the attack card itself. This card's text is 'when a <class> attack action card YOU CONTROL hits', which is the broadcast, and the engine has a separate trigger for it (ON_ANY_HIT, split out precisely so the two cannot be confused). On ON_HIT this equipment never heard another card's hit and the whole ability was dead. See tests/test_on_hit_is_not_broadcast.py.
